identity.legacyNote: 站内旧数据把此键写成古印度的'Keśin'、'耆那教/非暴力哲学'、'早期耆那教非暴力奠基者'，并引《阿笈摩》《经造支》与甘地；该内容与《卡格姆尼教谕》无关，属另一传统人物的错配，本包整体纠正 country（古印度→古埃及）、school（耆那教/非暴力哲学→古埃及教谕文学）、era（约前6—前5世纪→第三/第四王朝之交的归名朝代＋中王国文本层）。旧数据的全部 bio 内容作废，不再逐句改写保留。另注：既有《普塔霍特普》资料包把同一人物写作'卡格姆尼（Kagemni）'（Gunn 拼作 Ke'gemni），与本包的站内键'凯格姆尼'为同一人。

sources.readScope: 保全2026-10-06实际阅读：原站（www.ucl.ac.uk 与旧域 digitalegypt.ucl.ac.uk）直连返回 403、web_fetch 因代理返回非公网 IP 亦不可用；改用 Wayback Machine 快照读取：midegsummaries.html 取 2006-05-01 快照（旧域）、literature 目录页取 2005-09-29 快照。读到：'Teaching for Kagemni. Preserved on a single late Middle Kingdom copy, Papyrus Prisse…A vizier, not identified by name on the surviving part, gives his teaching to his son, Kagemni…The last lines record that king Huni died, and the Presence of king Snefru rose as effective king in this entire land, and Kagemni was made overseer of the city and vizier. sources.title: Battiscombe Gunn (tr.), The Instruction of Ptah-Hotep and the Instruction of Ke'Gemni（1906；Project Gutenberg #30508）
sources.coverage: Prisse 纸草的描述与获藏献藏史（1846/47 获藏、1847 刊布并献巴黎国家图书馆、现存 18 页、卷首缺损、原卷含两部书）；'文本未说由他写成／卡格姆尼可能是作者之子'；归名朝代记为第三王朝末胡尼朝（其绝对纪年不取）；孟菲斯卡格姆尼墓不早于第五王朝、难与归名者视为一人；《卡格姆尼教谕》第1—5 节译文与末段叙事全篇；自注'原抄本不分节'。全文下载本地精读。
sources.readScope: 保全2026-10-06实际阅读：Gutenberg 全文（pg30508.txt，108098 字节）本地精读其中 Ke'Gemni 部分：导言关于 Prisse 纸草的描述与获藏献藏史（1846/47 获藏、1847 刊布并献巴黎国家图书馆、展开约 23 英尺 7 英寸、现存 18 页、卷首缺损、原卷至少含两部书、此为前一部仅存末两页）、'It has always been attributed to this person since its discovery, but examination of as much of the book as exists will show that it is not said to have been written by him…The unnamed Vizier, who called his children to him, can hardly be Ke'gemni, who was not raised to the rank of Vizier and Governor of a city until afterwards. Ke'gemni may well have been a son of the author.'、'the date of writing is given as the end of the reign of Heuni, the last King of the Third Dynasty'（其绝对纪年已过时，不采用）、'A fine tomb of a certain Ke'gemni exists at Memphis…this tomb cannot be earlier than the Fifth Dynasty…so that the theory that they are one person may be dismissed as highly improbable. No other person of the name is known.'；译文《THE INSTRUCTION OF KE'GEMNI》全篇（第1—5 节及末段叙事，含'Then was Ke'gemni made Governor of his City and Vizier.'）与译者注'[1] The original is not divided into sections.'。未读：Gunn 书中的 Ptah-hotep 与 Amenemhe'et 部分（另见本批次其他包）。 新Gutenberg索引200及公开UTF8全文GET200108138字节，实读印22—24纸草/作者段、印28—29同名墓段、《KeGemni》印62—64全部五节/结文/译注。未重读全部PtahHotep；1906绝对年代弃用，获藏细节与今BnF资料不同。

uncertainties: 归名人物、故事场景、文本成书与抄本年代不能相互替代；中埃及语及中王国抄本并不能单独精确定出全部创作阶段。

historicalSources.readScope: 原站（www.ucl.ac.uk 与旧域 digitalegypt.ucl.ac.uk）直连返回 403、web_fetch 因代理返回非公网 IP 亦不可用；改用 Wayback Machine 快照读取：midegsummaries.html 取 2006-05-01 快照（旧域）、literature 目录页取 2005-09-29 快照。读到：'Teaching for Kagemni. Preserved on a single late Middle Kingdom copy, Papyrus Prisse…A vizier, not identified by name on the surviving part, gives his teaching to his son, Kagemni…The last lines record that king Huni died, and the Presence of king Snefru rose as effective king in this entire land, and Kagemni was made overseer of the city and vizier. The fragment seems similar in content to the Teaching of Ptahhotep; the setting in the reigns of Huni and Sneferu of the early Old Kingdom, some seven hundred years earlier than the Middle Egyptian language in which the teaching is written…'；目录页把该篇列在'Literary Compositions of the Middle Kingdom'的 Teachings 类下并标注'（not translated）'，即 UCL 未提供该篇译文。未读到：UCL 无该篇的转写与翻译页，故本包不引其文本。

historicalSources.title: Battiscombe Gunn (tr.), The Instruction of Ptah-Hotep and the Instruction of Ke'Gemni（Wisdom of the East; London: John Murray, 1906；Project Gutenberg #30508）
historicalSources.readScope: Gutenberg 全文（pg30508.txt，108098 字节）本地精读其中 Ke'Gemni 部分：导言关于 Prisse 纸草的描述与获藏献藏史（1846/47 获藏、1847 刊布并献巴黎国家图书馆、展开约 23 英尺 7 英寸、现存 18 页、卷首缺损、原卷至少含两部书、此为前一部仅存末两页）、'It has always been attributed to this person since its discovery, but examination of as much of the book as exists will show that it is not said to have been written by him…The unnamed Vizier, who called his children to him, can hardly be Ke'gemni, who was not raised to the rank of Vizier and Governor of a city until afterwards. Ke'gemni may well have been a son of the author.'、'the date of writing is given as the end of the reign of Heuni, the last King of the Third Dynasty'（其绝对纪年已过时，不采用）、'A fine tomb of a certain Ke'gemni exists at Memphis…this tomb cannot be earlier than the Fifth Dynasty…so that the theory that they are one person may be dismissed as highly improbable. No other person of the name is known.'；译文《THE INSTRUCTION OF KE'GEMNI》全篇（第1—5 节及末段叙事，含'Then was Ke'gemni made Governor of his City and Vizier.'）与译者注'[1] The original is not divided into sections.'。未读：Gunn 书中的 Ptah-hotep 与 Amenemhe'et 部分（另见本批次其他包）。
